reviews.title: Amazing headset. Best color imo. Works on PS5 and PC too!
reviews.comment: Amazing headset. Ill say, after watching countless review and comparison videos to find exactly what I needed, I'm glad I finally went with this. I needed something I could connect to my PS5 and on my laptop for work at the same time. I wanted a very quick swap between the 2. This beast filled all my requirements. Great sound. Super long battery life. Great build and feels hefty and durable enough for long use. The pads are also perfect for glasses wearers too. I will say I prefer the Cobalt color over the PS version white one. I knew the USB transmitter would work on the PS but was a little worried the XBOX transmitter wouldnt work if connected to the PC because of how xbox likes to add their own proprietary method. Decided to buy it anyway since the XBOX method would only require an additional connection req and shouldn't affect normal 2.4 connection so I was still confident it would work. So for anyone else in the same boat, yes this version will work on PC and PS5 simultaneous connection. Connect the USB transmitter to your PS and the XBOX one to your PC.
reviews.author: MY

reviews.title: a must for 2 simultaneous audio sources
reviews.comment: Stop thinking and buy this.  I have a number other headsets, some for work, and some for gaming - including Logitech Lightspeed G733, Bose Quiet Comforts,  a nice Razer, a bunch of cheap ones, and more.  But if you are trying to use multiple sources SIMULTANEOUSLY, then this is the one for you.  It's the right balance between comfortable, quality audio, easy to use, and affordable.  It's got simple yet powerful controls, it can connect via 2 included 2.4ghz dongles, plus Bluetooth, and the mic mute function is spectacular (just flip it up).  I fell in love with this within 15 minutes and I've never looked back.  I wish I had found it sooner, but I thought of other brands as being higher quality.  I was wrong. I use this with a bluetooth connection to my Yealink office phone and with a 2.4 connection to my PC - plus the other USB dongle can move from gaming system (or other  computer) as needed.  I can talk to someone on the phone while listening to a video on my PC (sometimes needed for work).  I can independently adjust the volumes. That being said "super human hearing mode" is only useful for games as far as I can tell.  Also, you can't control the priority of the microphone.  If you are using it with the 2.4ghz dongle, say for a Teams meeting, and then you get a bluetooth call.  The blueooth call connects to the mic and the meeting loses it.  You still hear audio from both though.  And as soon as you disconnect from the the call, the 2.4 dongle gets the mic again.  Perhaps giving you that control would make the headset far more complicated, but it was the only part that took me a couple minutes to figure out.
reviews.author: Techguy

reviews.title: Mad Catz quality meets medieval torture device
reviews.comment: Don’t waste your time / money. Worthless product. Will not stay connected using 2.4 or BT methods. Sound quality is mid and not worth the asking price. At first was disconnecting consistently every couple mins and sound quality was tinny and distorted. There is a ‘feature’ that allows you to switch between normal/ok sound and bad quality sound (why would you make this a feature of your headphones???) but this was different, wayyy more distorted and everything sounded far away. So, I updated the firmware and software for the headset and the 2.4 transmitter. After that completed it became stable, sound quality improved (although I stand by my earlier statement that they are still not asking prices level of quality). However, not too long after thinking it’s fixed and all good, it then got worse. Now it disconnects whenever it feels like it :D This could be 5mins into using them or 36 and a half mins, or 2hours 6mins and 23secs. Who knows?! Also, post update it now hands sound back to external source when it randomly decides to disconnect. So playing games or watching a movie at night (whole reason I bought these is so I can keep gaming and not disturb anyone) and if I forget to turn my mixer down… it just blasts out of my speaker system and defeats the entire purpose of the headphones. I could go on about how they aren’t very comfortable, how poorly laid out the button and volume adjusters are, etc etc etc. but none of that matters if the one major feature, being a wireless headphone, fails to function in a consistent manner. Learn from my mistake. Save yourself from the inevitable pain and suffering that awaits you if you decide to purchase these woefully engineered cans…what an infuriating and torturous experience.
reviews.author: Brady

reviews.title: Best headset I’ve ever had
reviews.comment: Year later and it’s still just like new. Best head set I’ve owned. I love it. It really does have great audio, I can hear all the steps and their directions. It’s even great for just listening to music. It’s also just so so comfortable. If this ever breaks I’ll be getting another one.

reviews.title: High quality headset. App name is SWARM II use it.
reviews.comment: This will be long winded sorry. Here are the feature I have found so far as well as some pointers for anyone who doesn't want to read the whole thing. What you get: (1) 2 dongles one for Xbox one for PC and Playstation. (2) the headset made of pretty high-quality stuff in my opinion (3) a charging cable type C What app to use: SWARM II it has a purple icon with the turtle beach logo. You can update directly from the app it will tell you how. I do not know why it's not advertised. Has most of the options from the last app plus you can make your own equalizer presets. What you can do: Page One General Audio Setting/ custom equalizer: (1) turn off and on the Superhuman Hearing setting and choose from 3 separate settings (Non-Adjustable) Legacy, footsteps, and gunshots. (2) Choose from 4 Non-Adjustable audio presets or make up to 5 of your own. Page Two Mic settings: Not much to say here, you can change the sensitivity and make your own presets. Page Three Not much here either, map the mode button with two options and adjust the LED brightness on the dongles. Yes you can do this. Page Four Hyperlinks to help center, social media and tells you if your headset needs an update. Jesus... still long winded. THE ACTUAL REVIEW The difference between the stealth 700 gen 2 max and these is kind of insane. My biggest problems with the last generation was that it was made of primarily plastic and were super quiet, whereas these are made of pretty high quality materials (the actual hinges are made of metal, a big plus) and they are loud when you want them to be. At the moment my only complaint is the comfort has gone down just a bit. The earmuffs are harder than gen 2 but the trade off in actual quality is more than worth it. The amount of customization you get with these in the app is also a big improvement over the last gen. If you are looking to get some nice headphones these are for you.
reviews.author: Ghost
